name: Electricity cost
author: LocalWORK
description: What a task costs in electricity: GPU draw measured with nvidia-smi, plus the CPU's rated watts scaled by its load, plus the rest of the machine. Set your price per kWh. It is an estimate, not a meter reading.

settings.label: CPU watts at full load
settings.help: The CPU's rated power (TDP or PPT).

settings.label: Rest of the machine (watts)
settings.help: Board, memory, drives, fans and power-supply loss. Add the GPU here if it is not NVIDIA.

statusItems.label: Task
statusItems.tooltip: Electricity for the current or last task. Session total: ${session.cost}. Now: ${cost_per_hour} per hour at ${price_per_kwh} per kWh.
